natural.criteria: died of illness or old age (a disease name may be the label)

executed.criteria: executed after a sentence, a purge verdict or a summary order

assassinated.criteria: killed by an attacker who targeted this person for political ends

murdered.criteria: killed outside any judicial process and not a targeted assassination (torture, mob, rival)

killed.criteria: killed in war, battle or armed clash

accident.criteria: died in an accident (crash, traffic, explosion) with no proven foul play

custody.criteria: died in prison, a camp, exile settlement or detention, not by execution

unknown.criteria: dead, but the cause is not stated, unknown or disputed
